capabilities: attach multiple files to the current note with links in a single undoable edit
rename attachments to <note name>_<index>.<ext> with collision-safe indexing
downscale jpg, png and webp images to a pixel threshold before they enter the vault
attach original files unchanged via a separate command
respect Obsidian's default attachment folder setting
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list and not reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable meanwhile via BRAT or manually from releases. Documents memory limits on very large photos on mobile.
problem: Obsidian attaches files one at a time with original filenames and sizes, so users rename and downscale phone photos with scripts after adding them.
summary: Batch attachment tool that inserts multiple files into the current note as links, with optional note-based renaming and image downscaling.
